repository.description: The Prometheus monitoring system and time series database.

issue.body:

Fixes: #7042 
Fixes: #7128 

Improvements:
1. (Fixed by another PR as well) The reported issue of labels parsing error being skipped is fixed. Hence,
```
groups:
  - name: group
    rules:
      - alert: alert
        expr: expr
        labels:
          key : value
        foo: bar
```

will result to

```
[hsingh@localhost prometheus]$ ./promtool check rules rule.yml 
Checking rule.yml
  FAILED:
rule.yml: yaml: unmarshal errors:
  line 8: field foo not found in type rulefmt.Rule
```

2. Duplicate errors in the previous version related to yaml unmarshalling is fixed.
3. Shift to yaml v3 library across the application.

issue.title: promtool doesn't validate rule_group keys

repository.name: prometheus
repository.description: The Prometheus monitoring system and time series database.

issue.body:
**What did you do?**

Accidentally created an invalid rule group

```yaml
groups:
- name: Alerts
  rules:
  - alert: SnitchHeartBeat
    expr: vector(1)
  labels:
  - alert: TargetDown
    expr: up == 0
```

**What did you expect to see?**

That `promtool check rules` rejects rule file as invalid.

**What did you see instead? Under which circumstances?**

Valid rules file

**Environment**

* Prometheus version:

2.18.1

issue.title: Add option for validate rules and exit

repository.name: promxy
repository.description: An aggregating proxy to enable HA prometheus

issue.body:
We are currently validating alert rules with prometheus before deploy it to promxy. But today we are faced that prometheus missed some errors, and promxy refused to load them.

I suggest to add something like ```-dryRun``` option to promxy, which will validate recording/alert rules, and exit with appropriate code: 0 if no errors, any other if there are allors in rules. Then we will be able to validate rules by promxy.
